headline: Open and closed are not AI safety scores

argumentStructure.evidence: The incident demonstrates that containment, permissions, monitoring and stopping are separate controls; Hugging Face also reports a defensible use for a locally run open-weight model during forensics.
argumentStructure.inference: Access and governance labels alone do not predict a system’s deployed security or accountability; they change who can inspect, host, modify, restrict and investigate it.
argumentStructure.position: Readers and institutions should demand a control-and-accountability record rather than accept either open or closed as a proxy for safety.
